item.title: Will AI Reduce the Role of Healthcare Simulation Educators?
item.description: Will Artificial Intelligence (AI) reduce the role of the healthcare simulation educator? This question is increasingly asked as AI rapidly enters healthcare simulation through virtual patients, automated scenario facilitation, and AI-assisted debriefing tools. As these technologies advance, simulation educators naturally question their future role. If AI can run scenarios, adapt to learner responses, and generate […]

item.title: Pre-Briefing in Healthcare Simulation: Beginner’s Guide and Downloadable Template
item.description: Pre-Briefing serves as an essential first step in a healthcare simulation experience, yet this phase is often overlooked or rushed. item.description: Team Strategies & Tools to Enhance Performance & Patient Safety (TeamSTEPPS) is an evidence-based set of teamwork tools designed to optimize patient outcomes through the improvement of communication and teamwork skills among healthcare simulation professionals. item.description: Dr. Kathy Casey and Dr. Regina Fink have collaborated for over three decades to improve the role transition experiences of nurses, especially nursing students to practice.
